module: Unified WAL Wave 0 Bookie startup/readiness/new-scope reference harness

referenceSemantics.phaseOrder: compatibility then required devices then allocator then route then delete then durable local readiness then persistent readiness CAS then matching service info then ephemeral writable registration
referenceSemantics.persistentCas: bookieId plus expected store version plus expected readiness generation plus new record
referenceSemantics.mismatch: generation or incarnation mismatch demotes and remains non-writable
referenceSemantics.newScope: new BookieId, four disjoint root kinds, new incarnation, isolated credential scope, no OS mutation
referenceSemantics.rollback: any existing Profile authority or durability-unknown fact refuses old-binary same-scope rollback
referenceSemantics.normalAddIncrement: format/readiness read, remote I/O, hash, TLS, KMS/certificate, and control fsync are all zero

deterministicCoverage.deviceStatusMatrix: missing, partial, corrupt, and unknown mandatory remain non-writable
deterministicCoverage.recoveryStatusMatrix: allocator, route, and delete missing/corrupt/unknown/durability-unknown remain non-writable
deterministicCoverage.cas: conflict before apply remains unregistered; response loss after apply rereads exact record
deterministicCoverage.registration: stale state is demoted; service-info and writable response loss reread exact projections
